Confirm component is included in target product build.

finding_identity.interpretation: Layered identity describes observation correspondence only; it does not prove a vulnerability, fix, safety, miss, or disappearance.

observation.message: Candidate component-code match for CVE-2025-9900: TIFFReadRGBAImageOriented shifts raster by (rheight - img.height) before decoding; when caller raster height is smaller than image height, this can underflow the destination pointer. Product reachability and exploitability remain unverified. Product reachability and vulnerability status remain unconfirmed.

experiment: D31 libtiff CVE-2025-9900 ASan component replay

fix.method: apply the MR !732 code delta to a second extracted copy of the same pinned 4.7.0 source

interpretation: The pinned component reproduces an ASan invalid write in put8bitcmaptile after TIFFReadRGBAImageOriented computes its raster offset from an undersized caller height. The fixed-source comparison applies the upstream MR !732 delta to the same source snapshot. This is component-level evidence only; product build, caller reachability, affected OpenHarmony release and product impact remain unknown.
